maddeler.e:
أتشانأ (form VI)
# أَتَشَانَأُ (ʔatašānaʔu) /ʔa.ta.ʃaː.na.ʔu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَشَانَأَ (tašānaʔa)
# أَتَشَانَأَ (ʔatašānaʔa) /ʔa.ta.ʃaː.na.ʔa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَشَانَأَ (tašānaʔa)
# أَتَشَانَأْ (ʔatašānaʔ) /ʔa.ta.ʃaː.naʔ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَشَانَأَ (tašānaʔa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
